keyset.title: Keyset
keyset.profile_delete_prompt: Hichapụ "%s"? Enweghị ike imegharị nke a.
keyset.profile_new_tip: Mepụta profaịlụ e depụtaghachiri site na njikọ dị ugbu a
keyset.compare_hint: Họrọ ndịiche ka ị detuo site na isi mmalite n'ime profaịlụ nọ n'ọrụ. Enweghị ike iṅomi omume na-efu site na isi mmalite.
keyset.compare_no_differences: Profaịlụ ndị a nwere otu njikọ.
keyset.compare_missing_source_hint: Ihe omume a enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya, enweghịkwa ike iṅomi ya.
keyset.compare_source_tip: Gagharịa site na profaịlụ isi mmalite
keyset.compare_changed: Agbanwere profaịlụ. Nyochaa ndịiche emelitere tupu itinye akwụkwọ.
keyset.search_syntax_tip: Jiri @category, #ctrl/#shift/#alt ma ọ bụ $key. Nne na nna, ihe nkwado na braket na-amachibido okwu na ngalaba, mgbanwe ma ọ bụ igodo.
keyset.keyboard_hint: Họrọ ihe omume, wee pịa igodo ma ọ bụ òké
keyset.no_bindings: Ọnweghị ihe nkedo dabara nzacha ndị a.
keyset.capture_binding_tip: Pịa, wee pịa igodo ma ọ bụ òké
keyset.virtual_key_tip: Pịa iji nzacha site %s; mgbe ị na-ejide, kenye ntinye a
keyset.reset_all_prompt: Akara niile ga-alaghachi na ndabara ha.
keyset.error_generic: Enweghị ike ịchekwa mgbanwe a. Lelee ndekọ ahụ wee nwaa ọzọ.
keyset.error.shared_conflict: Ntọala gbanwere n'ihe atụ Minecraft ọzọ. Nyochaa ụkpụrụ emelitere wee nwaa ọzọ.
keyset.error.shared_sync: Enweghị ike iweghachite ntọala ekekọrịtara. A na-edobe njikọ gị ugbu a.
keyset.error.recovered: Enwetara profaịlụ mebiri emebi na ndabere.
keyset.error.storage: Enweghị ike ịgụ ma ọ bụ dee ihe nchekwa profaịlụ. Lelee ndekọ egwuregwu.
keyset.conflict_peers: Mme omume ndị ọzọ na njide a: %s
keyset.conflict_replace_tip: Wepu njikọ a na omume ndị ọzọ na-emegiderịta onwe ha
keyset.conflict_swap_tip: Bugharịa omume nke ọzọ gaa na njide omume a gara aga: %s
keyset.conflict_swap_unavailable: Ọ dị mgbe ekenyechara igodo nke megidere otu omume ọzọ
keyset.conflict_gone: Edozila esemokwu a ma ọ bụ gbanwee.
keyset.conflict_changed: Njikọ gbanwere na windo ọzọ. Nyochaa esemokwu ahụ ọzọ.
keyset.auto_profile_requires_world: Jikọọ ụwa ma ọ bụ ihe nkesa iji tọọ profaịlụ akpaka
keyset.auto_profile_set_tip: Jiri %s maka ụwa a ma ọ bụ ihe nkesa
keyset.selection_hint: Pịa igodo ma ọ bụ òké · Ụzọ mgbapụ adịghị ejikọta.
keyset.footer_hint: Mgbanwe na-echekwa ozugbo · Escape na-emechi onye nchịkọta akụkọ
keyset.native_hint: Kwụsị igodo MaLiLib · pịa ngwakọta, wee hapụ igodo ya
keyset.native_capture_prompt: Tinye ngwakọta, wee hapụ ya · Escape unbinds
keyset.transfer_import_prompt: Bubata profaịlụ site na %s JSON faịlụ na nchekwa mbufe Keyset ekekọrịtara? A ga-amafe profaịlụ ndị yiri ya.
keyset.transfer_exported: Ebupụrụ profaịlụ na nchekwa mbufe Keyset ekekọrịtara. Ndị ọzọ na-ewu Minecraft nwere ike ịnweta ya.
keyset.transfer_duplicate: Ọnweghị profaịlụ ọhụrụ. Profaịlụ ndị a adịlarị.
keyset.transfer_empty: Ebe faịlụ JSON ebutere na mbupụ na nchekwa mbufe Keyset ekekọrịtara na mbụ.
